notes: Matching per prompt_align.md (strict). Kela caseworker, Kela system and the Kela Overpayment Recovery Centre are treated as the same actor; differences are recorded in match_type_note. Citizen/landlord vs Kela counterparts of the same exchange are not matched. 'exact' = the node(s) are the same unit of work; 'merged' = the node also folds in another reference step; 'partial' = the node(s) cover only part of the step. order_checks: (predecessor, step) pairs from the reference predecessor lists, in reference step order, where both are matched; each step is represented by its primary (first-listed) matched node, which is the generated_pair; pairs whose primary nodes are the same node are skipped (listed in summary); the first 60 remaining pairs are checked. forward_len/reverse_len are shortest path lengths (edge count) on all generated edges, including loop-back edges; same_order is true when a forward path exists and is no longer than the reverse path, false when the reverse path is shorter or only a reverse path exists, 'not_connected' when neither exists. Evidence text in the generated map was ignored.
